# mergeah_connection_access (Resource)

Manage exclusions on an existing SHARED or ORGANIZATION connection. Destroy leaves exclusions unchanged and stops management. It does not revoke the connection.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure the provider as shown in examples/provider/provider.tf.
resource "mergeah_connection_access" "example" {
  connection_id             = "ed2988b5-e421-429c-87ab-769fa3c1bdd8"
  excluded_registered_users = []
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connection_id` (String) Merge API field `connection_id`. Changes require replacement.
- `excluded_registered_users` (Set of String) Merge API field `excluded_registered_users`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform resource identifier. See the Import section for its format.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mergeah_connection_access.example 'ed2988b5-e421-429c-87ab-769fa3c1bdd8'
```
